summary: This is a PEM-encoded RSA private key file. It contains the cryptographic material needed to decrypt messages, sign data, and authenticate as the owner of the corresponding public key. The key is base64-encoded between BEGIN and END markers, which is the standard format for storing private keys in files.

explanations.1: This line marks the start of a PEM (Privacy Enhanced Mail) formatted private key. The 'BEGIN PRIVATE KEY' tells tools what type of data follows.
explanations.2: This and the following lines contain the base64-encoded private key material. Base64 is used because it encodes binary data into readable text characters.
explanations.28: This line marks the end of the PEM block, telling tools that the key data is complete.
